_what: Launch-to-launch TRAINING nondeterminism on the L1 rig: two launches of the IDENTICAL command (--arm rl --seed 1 --steps 600 --batch 4 --il-form matched --grad-clip 100) diverge and end in different regimes.
_why_it_matters: It refutes 'seed 1 is the diverging seed' -- divergence is LAUNCH-dependent, not seed-determined -- and it means a same-seed relaunch on this rig is a FRESH DRAW, not a reproduction.
_step0_note: the two differing fields are wall-clock, not state
